newsitem.title: UK: C&W set to take over Videotron in UK - papers.
newsitem.headline: C&W set to take over Videotron in UK - papers.

text.p: Cable & Wireless Plc is close to buying control of Videotron Holdings Plc, the British cable arm of Canada's Le Group Videotron Ltee, two British newspapers reported on Sunday.

The Sunday Times and The Sunday Telegraph reported that C&W was close to a deal. Meanwhile, the Independent on Sunday said Bell Cablemedia Plc was close to winning control of Videotron Holdings in a 600 million stg deal.
C&W spokeswoman Jennifer Weller told Reuters the company declined to comment on the reports.
C&W, Bell Cablemedia and Videotron are already linked.
C&W owns 13 percent of Bell Cablemedia. Bell Cablemedia owns 26 percent of Videotron Holdings, the newspapers said.

"The agreement would provide C&W with a big stake in Britain's rapidly growing cable television industry and give its British arm, Mercury Communications, access to large numbers of local telephone customers," The Sunday Times said.
The Sunday Times said C&W may do the deal with Bell Cablemedia as a joint venture.
The Telegraph said the deal would allow C&W to consolidate its position in the British Telecommunications market.
Group Videotron of Montreal put its 56 percent stake in Videotron Holdings on the auction block in February, The Sunday Times said.
